sources.title: GoliathGames' Ultimate Guide to Urgot (Tips on EVERY Matchup! / 8M+ Mastery)

passive.name: Echoing Flames
passive.text: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

spells.name: Corrosive Charge
spells.text: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

spells.name: Purge
spells.text: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

spells.name: Disdain
spells.text: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

spells.name: Fear Beyond Death
spells.text: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

damage.value: Urgot deals physical damage through periodic leg blasts and Q, while Purge gives him sustained damage.

archetype.value: Urgot is a bruiser who charges into nearby enemies, shields himself, and unloads his weapon.

winCondition.value: Urgot can swing teamfights by fearing enemies with his ultimate while his W and passive shred them.

spikes.at: Urgot’s W reaches its turret-damage spike when maxed
spikes.why: Urgot can toggle it without a cooldown and weave in an auto attack after every three W attacks for extra DPS.

spikes.at: Urgot’s W reaches a zero-second cooldown at its final rank
spikes.why: Urgot can keep Purge available without waiting for its cooldown.

mistakes.value: Urgot players can mismanage wave clearing by failing to account for his passive.
Urgot players lose crucial opportunities when they miss his skill shots.
Urgot loses Purge’s champion-targeting priority if he uses it without first striking a champion with another ability.
